comment: Owner-edited model approvals (ADR-0016 section 3; CAP-MODEL-01, CAP-MODEL-11). Shipped with one owner entry (the AI analyst and AI process roles); nothing else is routable until the owner adds an entry. A model discovered by a catalog refresh but absent here is 'unreviewed' and is never routed. Entry format: {"provider": "<provider id>", "model_id": "<exact id from a catalog snapshot>", "roles": ["<role>"], "approved_by": "owner", "approved_at": "YYYY-MM-DD", "policy_version": "<owner policy hash or version label>", "lifecycle_reviewed_until": "YYYY-MM-DD" (only for providers whose list endpoint exposes no lifecycle, e.g. OpenAI and Gemini), "note": "..."}. Moving aliases (ids ending in -latest, or ids another catalog row lists as an alias) are refused. Replacing a pinned id requires a recorded regression evaluation (CAP-MODEL-11).

approvals.approved_by: owner (delegated to Claude Code under the owner's instruction of 2026-10-24 to build AI into the platform)
approvals.note: AI analyst (ASK, role analyst; read-only tools) and AI processes (morning brief, filing summaries, move explainer; backend/src/unknown/agents/processes) under the owner's USD 200.00 Anthropic authorisation of 2026-10-22 (caps in agents.json: 15.00/day, 2.00/job; per-process caps in ~/.unknown/config/ai_processes.json) and the owner's instruction of 2026-10-24 to build AI into the platform. All output is advisory.
